name: every_starter
caption:
IF OUR RAPTORS CORE FIVE WERE POKÉMON 🎮🏀

🧬 Mew: it can learn any move. Scottie Barnes, 23.5 points a night through 8 games
🐂 Tauros: once it starts running, it won't stop. RJ Barrett, Toronto-born, 21.6 points a night through 9 games
🥷 Ninjask: so fast it was long believed invisible. Immanuel Quickley, 5.8 assists a night through 8 games
🐼 Pangoro: charges in like a berserker. Collin Murray-Boyles, 5.0 rebounds in 22.1 minutes a night
😴 Snorlax: keeps eating even in its sleep. Jakob Poeltl, 61.1% from the field through 7 games

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If our core five were Pokemon, here's the team.
Scottie Barnes is Mew. Its DNA holds the code of every Pokemon, so it can learn any move. So can Scottie. Twenty-three point five a night through eight games.
beats.dlg: MEW CAN LEARN ANY MOVE.|23.5 POINTS A NIGHT!

beats.vo: RJ Barrett is Tauros. Once it starts running, it won't stop until it hits something. Our Toronto-born bull, twenty-one point six a night through nine games.
beats.dlg: TAUROS CHARGES HEADLONG.|21.6 POINTS A NIGHT!

beats.vo: Immanuel Quickley is Ninjask. It moves so fast it was long believed to be invisible. Quick by name, and five point eight assists a night through eight games.
beats.dlg: TOO FAST TO SEE.|5.8 ASSISTS A NIGHT!

beats.vo: Collin Murray-Boyles is Pangoro. It charges in like a berserker and doesn't care what hits it takes. Our bruiser: five boards a night in just twenty-two minutes.
beats.dlg: BASHES LIKE A BERSERKER.|5.0 REBOUNDS A NIGHT!

beats.vo: Jakob Poeltl is Snorlax. It keeps eating even while it's asleep. Poeltl just eats around the rim: sixty-one percent from the field through seven games.
beats.dlg: IT EATS EVEN IN ITS SLEEP.|61.1% FROM THE FIELD!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?
